messages:
Harper: Heads-up — the ferry from Larkspur is running at reduced speed due to heavy chop. ETA bumped +20m. Anyone commuting from Marin?
Nico: Yep thats me. Just saw the announcement. Gonna be a soggy sprint from pier to office.
Talia: Im on the 7:30 ferry. If its late I might hop in with Ravi who drives in from the Richmond side.
ferry-bot: Ferry advisory: Delays expected on Larkspur and Sausalito routes due to high winds. Please allow extra travel time; alternative bus shuttles available at the terminal.
Ravi: Can take 2 people from the Embarcadero lot if needed. Im leaving at 8:05. DM me your cross street.
Yuki: Also, a PSA for shoes — wet boards + metal grates = slippery. Bring dry socks or an extra pair. Im leaving a small bag of spare socks at the reception table labeled "Ferry victims".
front-desk: Note: reception has a box of plastic shoe covers and single-use towels — first-come first-served. Leave a sticky if you stash extras.
Harper: Thanks! If anyone wants a hot chocolate Im dishing out the left-over thermos at the lobby from 8:15.
Nico: Hot chocolate > soggy soul. Will take one.
Talia: If ferry is more than +25m Im jumping on the shuttle per the advisory. Anyone want me to grab them a cup if I get to the office first?
Ravi: If youre stuck at the pier, look for a white Subaru with a "Redwood" parking pass — Im idling for 5 mins to see if anyone waves.
Yuki: Lost-and-found alert: blue sunglasses with a tiny chip at the left temple were turned into reception after a near-dive onto wet boards.
Harper: Whoops thats mine — thank you! Can pick up after I dry off.
ferry-bot: Shuttle update: temporary shuttle service departing Pier 41 to Embarcadero every 12 minutes while ferry delays persist. Capacity limited.
Nico: I made it on the +20m ferry, disembarked soaked but morale restored by hot chocolate. Thanks Harper and reception!
Talia: Pulled into the lot with Ravi's help. Note for cyclists: avoid the breakwater path today, lots of spray.
Ravi: Dropped two folks at the lobby. Still room for one more on the way back if anyone is stranded late.
Yuki: If anyone needs a tiny sewing kit for torn umbrellas, I left one in the craft drawer in the kitchen.
Harper: Commute report: ferry was wavy but safe. Office perk proposal: subsidized waterproof shoe covers? :laughing:
front-desk: Facility reminder: commuter lockers open today for soggy gear. Please label items with name and date.
Nico: Thanks team — real-life coordination > calendar updates. :boat::coffee:
